title: Package hostile audit prompt as reusable skill spec
objective: Define how the full-type hostile audit prompt becomes a reusable AIOS review skill.
non_goals: Do not install a local Codex skill in this task.
Do not modify production safety policy.
Do not mark the skill adopted before a real PR review uses it.

acceptance_tests.description: Skill spec defines trigger, inputs, outputs, guardrails, and adoption phases.
acceptance_tests.expected: Reviewer can use the spec without private chat context.
